description: Official European statistics from Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union: two dozen headline figures - GDP, inflation, unemployment, population, government debt, energy prices, emissions and more - for the EU, the euro area, every member state and the EFTA and candidate countries. Pick a statistic and a country by name and the step returns the numbers, the change since last time and a table ready for a spreadsheet - no dataset codes to look up. For anything else, search the full catalogue of roughly 10,000 datasets, see what a dataset can be filtered by, pull figures from it down to individual NUTS regions, and watch it for new releases. No account or API key required.
